entries.reason: brought in for MetalKit's ModelIO vertex-descriptor bridge functions (registry/MetalKit/ios10modelbridge.json); it is a plain layout-description object (attributes, buffer layouts) with no dependency on ModelIO's real wall, the asset/mesh file importer
entries.effect: attributes and layouts are real mutable arrays; attributeNamed:, addOrReplaceAttribute:, removeAttributeNamed:, reset, setPackedStrides and setPackedOffsets all work as the header describes, computing real per-format component sizes (1 byte for the 8-bit formats, 2 for 16-bit and half, 4 otherwise) rather than assuming one width for everything
entries.source: the header of iOS 16.4 for the contract

entries.effect: name, format, offset, bufferIndex, time and initializationValue hold what is set; format defaults to MDLVertexFormatInvalid and initializationValue to (0,0,0,1), as the header documents
